query: SELECT a.name, a.slug, a.coverImageUrl AS animals_coverUrl, p.id AS photoId, p.url AS photos_coverUrl, p.isCover FROM animals a LEFT JOIN animalPhotos p ON p.animalSlug = a.slug AND p.isCover = 1 ORDER BY a.id;
